title: OnToPilot blob migration manifest
description: Output of BlobMigrationCommand.RunAsync: one record per blob uploaded (or planned for upload in dry-run) from the Python filesystem layout blobs/<aa>/<bb>/<sha256> into the MinIO bucket. Task 4's Assert-AllMigrationManifests gate loads this file and validates every entry against this schema before allowing the cutover to proceed.

version.description: Manifest format version (semver). Bumped only when the schema shape changes.

sourceDirectory.description: Absolute path of the Python blob root that was walked to produce this manifest. Matches backend/data/blobs/ in production.

bucket.description: MinIO bucket the blobs were uploaded into (or would be uploaded into, in dry-run mode).

generatedAtUtc.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp at which the migration command finished writing the manifest.

entries.description: One record per blob. Order is deterministic: ascending SHA-256 hex so the manifest is byte-identical across runs.

sourcePath.description: POSIX-style legacy layout path relative to the source root, e.g. 'ab/cd/abcdef0123...'.

objectKey.description: Object key written to MinIO. Identical to the source path because MinioBlobStore uses BlobKey.LegacyPathFor(sha) — the same {aa}/{bb}/{full_sha} layout. This is what makes Document.storagepath portable across the cutover.

size.description: Byte length of the blob. Matches FileInfo.Length on the source file.

sha256.description: Lowercase-hex SHA-256 digest of the blob bytes. The first four hex chars are the shard prefix; the full digest is the object key.

referenceCount.description: Number of document.storagepath rows that reference this blob (>= 1 — zero-reference blobs are skipped and never appear here).
